$Comment: A Roll grants what ELSE a cycle handed over. How MUCH of the thing you made is the action's own Recipe.Yield, which is purely deterministic; a Roll can only ever ADD to it (Grants.OutputItems, whole extra items of that same output), never multiply it. This table is purely the cycle-count find ladder, so it grants drop lists rather than output items. Ladder.Factors is a FactorRef[] summed before the floor lookup; a single-factor ladder authors a one-element array. Grants.DropLists is a plural array, so a floor can roll a guaranteed common table plus a rare one as two independent entries; each entry rolls once through the native ItemModule.getRandomItemDrops. Floors resolve through the one shared ladder core every other ladder in this schema uses: the highest reached Min wins, a Min of 0 is reachable, and two floors sharing a Min is a validator warning because only the last authored one could ever grant.
